variety_description: High yielding, late maturity, medium tall, medium bold, variety suitable for cultivation under irrigated lowland conditions. Developed by BRRI and released in 2008 for cultivation in saline prone areas of Bangladesh in Boro season. Tolerate salinity up to 12-14 dS/m during seedling stage and 6 dS/m during other growth stages.  Susceptible to shattering. Low protein content.
